content_fields.title: Test if your site is vulnerable to CSRF
content_fields.description: Require a CSRF token, or an equivalent non-ambient credential, on every state-changing request.
content_fields.finding: A state-changing PATCH is accepted with no CSRF token and no origin check.
criteria: Every non-idempotent route rejects a request without a valid CSRF token when cookie authentication is in play.
The comparison uses a constant-time function.
A cross-origin form POST to /profile fails.
